text:
No option can be put forward from this run because the monthly-churn-under-4% limit could not be checked.

- The comparison treated higher MRR as the objective and held up under the tested changes, but that is not a finding that any option meets your churn requirement.
- The result rests partly on Olumi’s provisional inputs for Pro subscriber base, new Pro sign-ups, monthly churn and feature-release value—not measured or user-supplied figures.
- To make the constraint testable, the model needs the part of the model to which the 4% churn limit applies specified; merely restating the limit will not resolve it.
